模型请求失败，请检查模型 ID、协议和兼容性参数。: Model request failed. Check the model ID, protocol, and compatibility parameters.
models.json 过大，请先检查文件。: models.json is too large. Check the file first.
配置已被其他程序修改，请重新打开后再保存。: Another program modified the configuration. Reopen it before saving.
models.json 中没有有效的供应商配置。: No valid provider configuration in models.json.
供应商的 models 必须是数组。: The provider's models must be an array.
请求头必须是名称与文本值组成的对象。: Request headers must be an object of names and text values.
供应商 ID 只能包含英文字母、数字、点、短横线和下划线。: Provider IDs may contain only English letters, digits, dots, hyphens, and underscores.
模型 ID 已存在，请编辑现有模型。: This model ID already exists. Edit the existing model.
新模型 ID 已有独立覆盖配置，请先处理冲突。: The new model ID already has separate overrides. Resolve the conflict first.
上下文与最大输出必须是非负整数；留空使用默认值。: Context and maximum output must be non-negative integers. Leave blank to use defaults.
最大输出不能超过上下文窗口。: Maximum output cannot exceed the context window.
请求头必须是名称与文本值组成的 JSON 对象。: Request headers must be a JSON object of names and text values.
供应商返回了空列表，可以手动添加模型。: The provider returned an empty list. You can add models manually.
复制连接、密钥和模型到 %s；用量查询单独配置。: Copy the connection, key, and models to %s. Configure usage queries separately.
移除 %s 的自定义连接和模型配置。会话记录、pi 登录凭据和独立用量配置会保留: Remove the custom connection and model configuration for %s. Session history, pi sign-in credentials, and separate usage configuration will be kept.
供应商已存在，请确认替换后再导入。: The provider already exists. Confirm replacement before importing.
请先选择要导出的供应商。: Select the providers to export first.
供应商配置无法导出为 JSON。: Could not export the provider configuration as JSON.
无法读取 models.json，请检查文件与权限。: Could not read models.json. Check the file and permissions.
供应商导入内容不能超过 8 MiB。: Provider import data cannot exceed 8 MiB.
请输入完整的 models.json 或有效的供应商导出内容。: Enter the complete models.json or valid exported provider data.
供应商导出格式或版本不受支持。: Unsupported provider export format or version.
暂不支持加密的供应商导入，请先在原客户端导出未加密配置。: Encrypted provider imports are not supported yet. Export an unencrypted configuration from the original client first.
导入内容的 providers 必须是非空对象。: providers in the import data must be a non-empty object.
供应商配置必须是 JSON 对象。: Provider configuration must be a JSON object.
供应商配置嵌套过深。: Provider configuration is nested too deeply.
JSON 对象不能包含重复字段。: JSON objects cannot contain duplicate fields.
每个模型必须是对象，且模型 ID 必须非空且唯一。: Each model must be an object with a non-empty, unique model ID.
供应商或模型字段的类型或数字无效。: Invalid field type or number in a provider or model.
连接、模型或用量配置尚未保存。: Connection, model, or usage configuration has unsaved changes.
新会话使用新配置；已运行的会话需重启 Agent。: New sessions use the new configuration. Restart the Agent for running sessions.
当前模型尚未保存。: The current model has not been saved.
从 %s 移除模型 %s，不会删除会话记录。: From %s, remove model %s. Session history will be kept.
思考档位清理失败: Could not clean up thinking levels
将从 %s 删除以下模型：%s。会话记录会保留。: Delete the following models from %s: %s. Session history will be kept.
改名会同步迁移 pi 登录凭据、用量配置及默认模型引用。请先保存连接更改。: Renaming also migrates pi sign-in credentials, usage configuration, and default model references. Save connection changes first.
将 %s 改为 %s，并迁移相关配置。: Rename %s to %s and migrate related configuration.
接口是否接受工具定义中的 strict 字段。: Whether the API accepts the strict field in tool definitions.
接口是否接受 temperature；部分推理模型不接受。: Whether the API accepts temperature. Some reasoning models do not.
供应商要求时启用，通常保持自动。: Enable when required by the provider. Usually leave on automatic.
接口是否接受 store 字段。: Whether the API accepts the store field.
接口是否支持 developer 角色，而不是仅支持 system。: Whether the API supports the developer role in addition to system.
接口是否接受 reasoning_effort 字段。: Whether the API accepts the reasoning_effort field.
流式响应是否支持返回 token 用量。: Whether streaming responses can return token usage.
供应商是否要求在工具结果消息中传递工具名称。: Whether the provider requires tool names in tool result messages.
把思考内容按普通文本格式发送给兼容接口。: Send thinking content as plain text to compatible APIs.
供应商是否要求助手历史消息包含 reasoning_content。: Whether the provider requires reasoning_content in past assistant messages.
填写的连接信息尚未保存。: The entered connection details have not been saved.
接下来获取模型列表，或手动添加模型。: Next, fetch the model list or add models manually.
先填写连接信息，保存后继续管理模型和用量。: Enter and save connection details first, then manage models and usage.
自定义中转选择 OpenAI 兼容接口；也可以使用 pi 内置供应商的地址和协议: Choose an OpenAI-compatible API for a custom relay. You can also use a built-in pi provider's URL and protocol.
例如 my-provider；用于区分连接，只能使用英文、数字、点、短横线和下划: For example, my-provider. Identifies the connection; use only English letters, digits, dots, hyphens, and underscores.
一般中转使用 OpenAI Chat Completions；请以供应商文档为准: Most relays use OpenAI Chat Completions. Refer to the provider's documentation.
例如 https://api.example.com/v1，填写 API 根地址: Enter the API base URL, for example https://api.example.com/v1.
可填写密钥或环境变量名；OAuth 登录用户可留空，到“登录与密钥”完成登录。: Enter a key or environment variable name. OAuth users can leave this blank and sign in under Sign-in and keys.
不确定模型 ID 时留空，保存后从供应商获取列表。: If unsure of the model ID, leave blank and fetch the list from the provider after saving.
配置连接后添加模型，再按需开启用量查询。: Configure the connection, add models, then enable usage queries as needed.
与供应商文档中的接口保持一致；不确定时先选 OpenAI Chat Comple: Match the API in the provider's documentation. If unsure, start with OpenAI Chat Completions.
填写 API 根地址，例如 https://api.example.com/v1: Enter the API base URL, such as https://api.example.com/v1, without the full chat endpoint path.
可填密钥、环境变量名，或以 ! 开头的命令；留空时沿用 pi 的登录凭据。: Enter a key, environment variable name, or command starting with !. Leave blank to use pi sign-in credentials.
通常留空；可按供应商要求配置 User-Agent 等请求头。不要添加换行。: Usually leave blank. Add headers such as User-Agent if required by the provider. Do not include line breaks.
供应商级兼容性：默认继承 pi 判断；仅在供应商文档要求时覆盖。: Provider-level compatibility: use pi's defaults unless the provider's documentation requires overrides.
退出或重启会丢失未保存的文件修改。可以先取消，保存后再继续。: Quitting or restarting will discard unsaved file changes. Cancel to save your changes before continuing.
这些选项只影响当前模型；通常保持默认即可。: These options affect only this model. Defaults usually work best.
留空继承供应商请求头。: Leave blank to inherit provider request headers.
该模型新会话使用的档位；留空继承全局设置。: Thinking level for new sessions using this model. Leave blank to inherit the global setting.
只有供应商实际支持时才开启扩展档位；已有自定义映射会保留。: Enable extended levels only if supported by the provider. Existing custom mappings will be kept.
上下文超过阈值后使用该档价格；阈值按 tokens 递增，价格单位为美元 / 百: Each tier's prices apply above its context threshold. Thresholds increase in tokens; prices are in USD per million tokens.
请填写每个价格档位的输入 tokens 阈值。: Enter an input token threshold for each pricing tier.
价格与阈值必须是有效数字。: Prices and thresholds must be valid numbers.
模型高级配置已保存，但默认思考档位保存失败：%s: Advanced model configuration saved, but could not save the default thinking level: %s
将从 pi 模型目录恢复 %s 的能力、价格和兼容性配置。: Restore capabilities, pricing, and compatibility settings for %s from the pi model catalog.
先保存连接设置，再添加或修改模型。: Save connection settings before adding or editing models.
模型 ID 必须与供应商实际提供的 ID 一致。获取列表后勾选添加，也可以手动填: Model IDs must match those provided by the provider. Fetch the list and select models to add, or enter them manually.
测试模型会发送一次最小请求，可能产生少量费用。: Testing sends a minimal model request and may incur a small charge.
新建会话将使用这个模型。: New sessions will use this model.
还没有模型。请获取列表或手动添加第一个模型。: No models yet. Fetch the list or add your first model manually.
从供应商模型列表或 API 文档复制，区分大小写。: Copy from the provider's model list or API documentation. Case-sensitive.
仅用于界面显示；留空时显示模型 ID。: Used only for display. Leave blank to show the model ID.
模型一次能处理的总 token 数；留空沿用默认值。: Total tokens the model can process at once. Leave blank to use the default.
一次回复的最大 token 数；不能超过上下文窗口。: Maximum tokens per response. Cannot exceed the context window.
价格仅供费用估算，单位为美元 / 百万 tokens；留空表示未配置。: Prices are for cost estimates, in USD per million tokens. Leave blank if not configured.
粘贴 models.json 内容，先预览，再确认导入。现有供应商默认不会被覆盖: Paste models.json content, preview it, then confirm the import. Existing providers are not overwritten by default.
复制配置以备份或迁移。默认移除密钥和认证请求头，导入后需重新填写。: Copy the configuration for backup or migration. Keys and authentication headers are removed by default and must be entered again after importing.
包含密钥和认证信息（请勿公开分享）: Include keys and authentication data (do not share publicly)
允许替换同名供应商（只替换本次导入的项目）: Allow replacing providers with the same name (only imported entries)
替换同名供应商？: Replace providers with the same name?
本次导入的同名连接、密钥和模型将被替换，请确认已备份。: Matching connections, keys, and models in this import will be replaced. Make sure you have a backup.
将移除以下供应商的连接和模型：%s。会话记录与 pi 登录凭据会保留。: Remove connections and models for these providers: %s. Session history and pi sign-in credentials will be kept.
超时必须是 1 到 300 秒的整数。: Timeout must be an integer from 1 to 300 seconds.
刷新间隔必须是 0 到 1440 分钟的整数，0 表示仅手动。: Refresh interval must be an integer from 0 to 1440 minutes. 0 means manual only.
请先加载供应商连接配置。: Load the provider connection configuration first.
余额、套餐额度和订阅窗口由供应商接口提供。这里的配置不会改变聊天使用的密钥。: Balances, plan quotas, and subscription windows come from the provider's API. These settings do not change the key used for chat.
自动识别支持的供应商；第三方中转可选择对应面板模板。: Automatically detect supported providers. For third-party relays, select the matching panel template.
未匹配专用查询方式，将尝试通用 /v1/usage 接口。可选择其他模板或填写查: No dedicated query method matched. The generic /v1/usage endpoint will be tried. You can choose another template or enter a query URL.
默认填写服务根地址；通用模板指定余额字段路径时，可填写完整查询 URL。: Normally enter the service base URL. With the generic template and a balance field path, you can enter a full query URL.
使用面板个人设置中的访问令牌，通常与聊天 API Key 不同。: Use the access token from your panel profile settings. It usually differs from the chat API Key.
New API 面板用户 ID，用于 New-Api-User 请求头。: New API panel user ID for the New-Api-User request header.
填写完整的登录 Cookie，仅用于该面板的查询请求。: Enter the full sign-in Cookie, used only for queries to this panel.
例如 /api/user/self；这是网站接口路径，不是本地文件。: For example, /api/user/self. This is a website API path, not a local file.
用于签名查询，请勿填写聊天 API Key。: Used to sign queries. Do not enter a chat API Key.
留空使用聊天凭据；面板登录令牌用于查询订阅与充值。: Leave blank to use chat credentials. The panel sign-in token is used for subscription and top-up queries.
只用于面板套餐查询。: Used only for panel plan queries.
允许面板令牌过期后刷新；更新后的令牌会安全保存。: Allow refreshing expired panel tokens. Updated tokens are saved securely.
留空使用供应商连接或 pi 登录凭据。: Leave blank to use provider connection or pi sign-in credentials.
例如 data.balance；留空按常见响应格式识别。: For example, data.balance. Leave blank to detect common response formats.
例如 data.currency；按接口返回的币种显示。: For example, data.currency. Displays the currency returned by the API.
查看用量时按此间隔刷新；0 表示仅手动刷新。: Refresh at this interval while viewing usage. 0 means manual refresh only.
原有余额配置会保留。保存上方的用量配置后，新的查询方式优先。: Existing balance configuration will be kept. After saving the usage configuration above, the new query method takes precedence.
可点击测试查询，确认供应商返回的余额或额度。: Click Test query to check the balance or quota returned by the provider.
添加供应商连接，然后管理该供应商的模型。每个供应商的用量查询可单独设置。: Add a provider connection, then manage its models. Usage queries can be configured separately for each provider.
搜索供应商名称、协议或地址: Search provider name, protocol, or URL
用于新建 pi 会话；工具模型在下方单独指定。: Used for new pi sessions. Tool models are specified separately below.
独立账户可使用不同的查询凭据；各供应商的余额或套餐查询请在“供应商与模型”中设置: Separate accounts can use different query credentials. Configure provider balance or plan queries under Providers and models.
在供应商的模型管理中点“收藏”，或在输入框的模型菜单里点星标；可在这里调整顺序。: Click Pin in the provider's model management, or the star in the input box's model menu. Reorder pinned models here.
翻译窗口使用的供应商与模型。: Provider and model used by the translation window.
不启用：选择供应商后开启: Disabled: select a provider to enable
请先添加供应商和模型，再为工具选择模型。: Add a provider and models before choosing a model for the tool.
还没有供应商。添加连接后，获取模型列表或手动添加模型，即可开始使用。: No providers yet. Add a connection, then fetch the model list or add models manually to get started.
没有匹配的供应商，可清空搜索或添加新的供应商。: No matching providers. Clear the search or add a new provider.
连接设置管理密钥和地址；模型管理负责添加、编辑、排序及收藏；用量查询单独保存。: Manage keys and URLs in Connection settings; add, edit, reorder, and pin models in Model management. Usage queries are saved separately.
已选 %d 个；搜索不会清除已选项。仅添加勾选的模型。: %d selected. Searching keeps your selections. Only checked models will be added.
搜索远程模型名称或 ID: Search remote model name or ID
没有可添加的新模型；已有模型不会重复添加。: No new models to add. Existing models will not be duplicated.
